newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus says is open to structural change.
newsitem.headline: Fokus says is open to structural change.

text.p: Fokus Bank, Norway's fourth largest bank, said on Friday it was open to structural change and did not see it as a goal to stay independent in the long run.
Managing Director Bjarne Borgersen said the planned cooperation with Union Bank of Norway (UBN) would be discussed at a board meeting on September 3-4.
"We are only talking about a cooperation agreement now, but if things go well it can develop into something more," he said at a presentation of the bank's six-month result to analysts.

UBN and Fokus announced on May 7 they had started talks to establish cooperation based on both banks continuing as independent entities. They also launched a joint cooperation in insurance with Danish insurer Codan Forsikring.
UBN, Norway's largest savings bank, said recently the development of the partnership with Fokus would be one of the bank's most important tasks in the future.
UBN and Fokus have said they expect to conclude talks on a comprehensive cooperation package by the end of August.
